fields.title: Namhae Branch Appendix: Hidden Truths
fields.body:
#### Hidden Truths
- Workers are recycled products with a 100-day shelf life, filled with an orange raw material; the sticker covers its injection port, and removing it drains and kills them.
- Every 30 days ("Worker Cleanup") they are sedated, bound, and carted up a rail line to the Processing Facility, a deformed toy-factory Uh-doom (Scan, Standardize, Sticker Removal, Raw Material Check, Recycling) that melts them and reissues them, memories reset to hiring, in boxes labeled "Shelf life: 100 days 👍 Still recyclable after expiry!" One batch is 999. Staff added locks and a "Custom 26" setting; its Basic, Special, and Custom Recycling modes are mostly unexplored.
- So no Worker finishes 100 days or leaves with money, and one who "has been here two weeks" may have been here for months.
- Branch Security is unexplained: suits appear where no guard should be; one wore the face of an employee declared dead in an Uh-doom.
- Seed: Worker Cleanup night comes early.

fields.title: Namhae Branch Appendix: Facilities and Registered Uh-doom
fields.body:
#### Facilities
- Worker Zone: assembly hall split into X/Y/Z pens like a cattle shed, dorms, canteen, store (5,000 won a cigarette), vending-machine clinic at extreme prices; wiretaps and CCTV with occasional blind spots.
- Leisure Zone (Sundays): a tacky bulb-lit rural night street of mostly unstaffed shops at several times outside prices: Namhae Bar, Happy Lottery, Rhythm Karaoke, Sleep Care (massage chairs, Baekilmong hair-loss pills, unprescribed drugs, "Painkiller – 300,000 (EXTRA STRONG!)"), arcade, comic room, and a Religious Activity corridor (one faith per room, Sunday fortune-teller, last room a dried rite table with a pig's head). "Staff Only" doors hide staff areas. Nobody steals; everyone has seen the price.
- Containment Zone: by mine cart; identical dark grey doors, red-lit cells, some earth-floored.
- Staff Zone: 2000s public-corporation offices, sectors such as B-5 and B-9, storerooms, a Worker management room behind a one-way mirror.
- Old Facility: sealed behind earth walls and a disused staff bathhouse since a cost-cutting renovation six years ago (which split staff and containment areas with one door, below HQ standards). Steel corridors, hand-wheel doors, surveillance gallery, emergency exits, doors with a distinctive "Staff Only" handle crest, and a central control system bootable in safe mode. A former manager's office, administrator account, and early Uh-doom documents remain.
- Loudspeaker: "Good morning! All Workers, please prepare for today's work~", "Roll call in ten minutes. Get rich today too~", "Lunch time! Eat well and make lots of money this afternoon~", "When you're desperate: Dream Money, Dream Life!", "Leisure Zone opening. Fighting this week too! Get rich!" Emergency alarm: "[EMERGENCY!] All employees still inside, evacuate via the escape routes!" Workers are told the old mine misfires and to ignore it; it is for regular staff only.

#### Registered Uh-doom on Site
- White Cord (하얀 끈, Qterw-A-89, Darkness), the native Uh-doom; its 500 m exclusion was ignored to convert old buildings into dorms. Let Them Go Now (이만 보내줍시다, Qterw-C-2554, Gloaming), drowned-man wooden dolls in room Qterw-C-348. Let There Be No Light (빛이 없으라, Qterw-C-1010, Gloaming), used for Night Special Work. Fear Cleaner (피어 클리너, Qterw-C-219, Gloaming), 25-person cleaning jobs. Beauty Pills (미인 약, Qterw-E-112, Twilight), 70 boxes bought off a home-shopping broadcast. An uncoded crying-face coin purse, an easy "honey job."

fields.title: Delusion Home Shopping Appendix: Catalog Examples
fields.body:
#### Catalog Examples
- These are examples of the pattern, not the full stock. New products follow the same pattern.
  - Samra-Manshang Co. "Into the Vacuum": containers that stop food decay forever; comparatively peaceful.
  - Happy-Maker: narcotic-grade painkiller sticks; the model looked far too happy; addictive.
  - Gold-Edition Blood Bathtub: restores youth; do not ask what fills it.
  - Aesthetic-Caterpillar Egg-Sac Diet Aid: leech-toothed worms eat fat first, then tunnel and liquefy organs.
  - Beauty Pills (BB, "Become Beautiful"): pink translucent soft capsules, 120 per bottle. Pitch (June 1, 19XX): "Everyone, look at the model in this magazine ad. Isn't she dazzling? Today's new product is an amazing pill that lets you become just as dazzling…" Instructions: one pill each morning with liquid; over three days the body improves and gains aesthetic beauty (scars, swelling, posture, facial balance truly improve). Under the sticker, embossed judgment gates, purgatory, sulfur, notes, staff lines: "Create your own beautiful instrument! The ■■ care method beloved by the Purgatory Choir. Suitable for ■■." Alcohol after the third pill triggers the original effect in sleep: the body becomes a living instrument and the Choir comes to tune and collect it (see 화요퀴즈쇼). Baekilmong grade: Twilight.
  - Bad Luck Post-it (불운 포스트잇): "Is there an acquaintance you hate to death? The old superstition of the curse talisman is now real. Mourn their unfortunate accident with a simple trap!" Tip: the more superstitious the target, the faster and stronger. Conditions: the target must be the user's acquaintance, must find and read it personally, and must be flustered. "Hyeolhyung (혈흉) guarantees a valid effect only when every precaution is observed."
  - Egg Mood Lamp (계란무드등, 繼卵 "succession egg"), certified genuine, from Sunshine Select Shop (햇살편집숍): its light and shadow show a creature growing and hatching in the egg, and the result can be used alone: "Use the nerves and muscles of the creature you observed! Enjoy cool special effects!" Needs 2 ml of the creature's blood, 3 cm of its hair, 100 ml saline, in unlit darkness or shade. Open the adhesive side, attach near the spinal cord where it meets the brain, and wear it. Never wake the result; after a week of continuous use stop and recharge; never force it off; stop when adhesion weakens; do not let the result die. Recommended use: the creature's lifespan.

fields.title: Let There Be No Light Appendix: The Monastery and the Lover of Paradise
fields.body:
#### Light-Starter Route
- A supply closet beside the lobby's left staircase stands open over a pit-like space of cleaning gear. A cork board holds a sheet with a faint test stamp and a stamp cap on red string; sliding it aside reveals a stairless black hole. Entering means falling into a cellar cut into the cliff under the retreat, mountain wind blowing in, Fairy Rock directly below: the students fell or leapt from here. The four stamp images read "Descent · Cliff · Retreat."
- The cellar is Sinmaeum Monastery (신마음수도원), a Sarangnakwon shrine. Plaque: "The only name of paradise / is a love you cannot refuse." It is crammed with religious objects (Buddha, Marys, crosses, prayer beads, an ox-head bust, a split head showing blood-red ruby and glowing eyes, a container of severed rat heads, a burnt-match idol, a gold censer) and a twine-bound cylindrical idol with exaggerated carved features and folded hands wedged in the floorboards. The fourth stamp lies between the match idol and the censer.
- Touching that idol, above all bleeding on its twine, calls the Lover of Paradise; stamping the fourth stamp turns the surroundings "bright and beautiful" as it arrives. The fourth stamp on clothing, submitted at the Prize Office, lets the light-starter clear.

#### Lover of Paradise (낙원의 연인)
- Worshipped by Sarangnakwon (사랑낙원), an early-2000s cult that promised "you will meet your ideal type," ran a children's home as a front, and forced rites remaking members into something fit for it. "Something supremely beautiful and good that you must love," seen as the beholder's ideal; beyond human cognition and far above the mountain's grade.
- Glimpsed as long fingers with balsam-red, nacre-sheened nails; announced by a polite knock (knock knock knock). Verses play inside the head regardless of hearing: "My love like a hawthorn tree, your love is fair and lovely." / "I have come in answer to the call. Turn and receive me." / "I wait so long and you do not turn." Over a phone, others hear only strange creaking and slapping flesh.
- It brings longing, family-reunion joy, guilt, acceptance, and pain melting away; judgment is contaminated first (going below alone may already be its pull). The body turns on its own, neck twisting, arms bending back; first person slips ("My love.", "You called me."); release brings sobbing as after betrayal. Students who saw it smiled and stepped off the cliff.
- Never turn, look, open a door, or speak to it. Any answer or question acknowledges it, and "what I have permitted needs no second permission": it then opens even locked doors. It needs no air. Hold on by biting the mouth, digging nails in, loud real sound (alarm, ringing phone, a voice on the line), nonstop talk; the 1st-prize glasses hide it for a moment, though its presence stays.
- Whoever bled on its idol keeps fine handprints in their blood and may hear it knocking at their door after the clear; how long and how far it follows is unknown.
